lines.text_source: To activate the orb, think of someone who has ample knowledge of the power you call 'magic'.
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: Para ativar o orbe, pense em alguém que tenha amplo conhecimento do poder que você chama de 'magia'.

lines.text_source: Go on, use the <color=OBJ>Electric Orb with the generator</color> to restore power to the portal. That crystal up there. Then jump onto the transporter's beacon and activate it to travel to the Floating Module.
lines.speaker: Brigard
lines.base_translation: Vá! Use o <color=OBJ>Orbe Elétrico no gerador</color> para restaurar energia ao portal. Aquele cristal lá acima. Depois pule no farol do transportador e ative-o para viajar ao Módulo Flutuante.
lines.risk_notes: Brigard (high criticality): formal-military register enforced; short clauses as commands; no colloquialisms. Color tag <color=OBJ>...</color> preserved verbatim. Multi-action sequence (use orb → jump → activate) demands clarity without fluff. pt-BR tendency to expand — kept concise (92→210 byte budget; within limits).
